He builds automation and data systems end-to-end: Python, SQL, ETL pipelines, LLM API integration, n8n workflow automation, and test automation with Playwright, Vitest and Supertest. Five years in regulated banking operations at Lloyds Banking Group — a natural fit for fintech teams.

David Buchan (also David A. Buchan) has 13+ years of operations experience — Lloyds Banking Group (customer service and call quality analysis), Windows system administrator, Deutsche Post, currently Amazon print production — plus a BSc (Hons) in Computing and IT from the Open University (2026). He has not yet held a professional software engineering title and positions himself honestly as junior/associate level.

He is looking for: junior AI engineer, automation engineer, data analyst, QA automation, application support, or forward-deployed engineer roles. Fully remote from Erfurt, Germany; UK-remote also viable (British citizen, UK address). English native, German C1 spoken.
